title: The Seven Husbands of Evelyn Hugo
author: Taylor Jenkins Reid
summary: A reclusive Hollywood icon finally agrees to tell her life story to an unknown journalist. Each of her marriages reveals a piece of the truth, and why she picked this writer.
readIf: You love old-Hollywood glamour and a story that builds toward a big emotional reveal.
skipIf: You want a light read, or domestic abuse is a topic you avoid.

pairings.reason: A lighter, funnier take on love, secrets and grief, with a similar emotional core.
Another love story shaped by public scrutiny, with a far more hopeful ending.
